findings.summary: The Admin Web cannot apply a fee rule it authored when the authored fee carries VAT, a minimum fee or a maximum fee.
findings.mechanism: CommercialApprovalInbox replays the approval's stored requestDetails to execute-create. ALLOWED_COMMERCIAL_REQUEST_DETAIL_KEYS (src/authorization/commercial-rule-governance.service.ts) omits vatBps, minimumFeeMinor and maximumFeeMinor (it lists minFeeMinor/maxFeeMinor, which the fee body never uses), so the replayed payload is not byte-identical to the approved one and the backend refuses the fingerprint comparison.

storedRequestDetails.reason: PR27 browser walkthrough — wallet transfer fee with VAT band

findings.serverEvidence: v1-commercial-configuration-authoring.integration.spec.ts passes because it replays the ORIGINAL proposal body, not the stored requestDetails.
